note: uyir a/aa/i - consecutive independent vowels, each its own ezhuthu
uyir au - the diphthong vowel (NFC single code point)
uyirmei ka - bare consonant carries the inherent /a/ vowel
uyirmei ke - consonant + e matra (left-side glyph, logically after)
uyirmei ko - two-part o matra (NFC single code point U+0BCA)
uyirmei koo - two-part oo matra (NFC single code point U+0BCB)
uyirmei kau - two-part au matra (NFC single code point U+0BCC)
mei k - consonant + pulli (pure consonant, vowel killed)
ksha - mei k + Grantha ssa segments into two ezhuthu (pulli breaks the cluster)
tamizh -> ta / mi / zh - the canonical multi-syllable example
vanakkam (hello) -> va / nna / k / ka / m
ahdu (that) -> a / aytham / tu - aytham inside a word
lakshmi -> la / k / sh / mi - ksh conjunct with two pulli
mixed - tamizh + space + ASCII digits, each non-Tamil char its own unit
pure ASCII passthrough - each character its own unit
uyirmei koo directly followed by a digit - cluster then digit boundary
